#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long modPow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1LL;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    long long phaseSize = 1LL;
    long long p = 1LL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        p = p * (n - i + 1) % MOD;
        p = p * modPow(n + m - i + 1, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        phaseSize += p;
        if (phaseSize >= MOD) phaseSize -= MOD;
    }

    long long answer = 0LL;
    long long comb = 1LL;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
        comb = comb * (n - k + 1) % MOD * modPow(k, MOD - 2) % MOD;

        long long numPhases = ((long long)m + k) % MOD * modPow(k, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        long long e = numPhases * phaseSize % MOD;
        long long term = comb * e % MOD;

        if (k & 1) {
            answer += term;
            if (answer >= MOD) answer -= MOD;
        } else {
            answer -= term;
            if (answer < 0) answer += MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << answer << '\n';

    return 0;
}
